origins.label: Arcane
origins.description: Spells of the nine color schools. Two arcane bonuses on one stat do not stack; the strongest counts.

origins.label: Divine
origins.description: Prayers, blessings, shrines, and relics. A row names it; nothing defaults to it.

origins.label: Primal
origins.description: Nature and spirit magic: totems, druidic and shamanic rites. A row names it.

origins.label: Alchemy
origins.description: Potions, elixirs, poisons, oils, and raw ingredients. A Fortify Strength +10 and a Giant Strength +5 give +10.

origins.label: Enchantment
origins.description: Magic effects on worn or wielded items, and engraved gems. Two rings of fire resistance give the larger one.

origins.label: Martial
origins.description: Stances, battle cries, and combat techniques. A row names it.

origins.label: Morale
origins.description: Inspiration, leadership, fear, and despair. A row names it.

origins.label: Environment
origins.description: Terrain, weather, light, and cover. A row names it.

origins.label: Equipment
origins.description: An item's own numbers: armor DR per slot, weapon damage. Every item counts.

origins.label: Trained
origins.description: Perks, features, and backgrounds. Every perk counts.

origins.label: Innate
origins.description: Ancestry and natural traits. Every trait counts.

origins.label: Condition
origins.description: Status conditions. Different conditions add; one condition is one source and counts once.
